nodes.title: START HERE
code:
SHMUP V
Joystick 2: move / fire.

Open the ORGs to explore commented code blocks and the existing graphics, scrolling, HUD, sprite, music and SFX macros.

LITE can view and run the code blocks; PRO can edit them.

WORLD contains 4x4 metatiles and the placed level in Map 0. WAVE_SCRIPT controls enemy sequences. ACTORS frame 4 is the entry fade; frame 3 is the full enemy.

; Enemy
; Read WAVE_SCRIPT records: path, start X, count and spawn spacing.

Enemy:
INC $C00D
JSR WaveSpawn
LDX #$00

EnemyLoop:
LDA $C028,X
BNE EnemyActive
JMP EnemyNext

EnemyActive:
INC $C024,X
LDA $C024,X
CMP #$E8
BCC EnemyPath
LDA #$00
STA $C028,X
JMP EnemyNext

EnemyPath:
INC $C02C,X
LDA $C034,X
BEQ EnemyStraight
CMP #$01
BEQ EnemyLeft
CMP #$02
BEQ EnemyRight
CMP #$03
BEQ EnemyZig
LDA $C02C,X
AND #$7F
TAY
LDA $B100,Y
CLC
ADC $C030,X
JMP EnemyStore

EnemyStraight:
LDA $C030,X
JMP EnemyStore

EnemyLeft:
LDA $C02C,X
LSR
STA $C019
LDA $C030,X
SEC
SBC $C019
JMP EnemyStore

EnemyRight:

LSR
CLC
ADC $C030,X
JMP EnemyStore

EnemyZig:
LDA $C02C,X
AND #$3F
CMP #$20
BCC ZigAscending
EOR #$3F

ZigAscending:
ASL
SEC
SBC #$1F
CLC
ADC $C030,X

EnemyStore:
STA $C020,X

EnemyNext:
INX
CPX #$04
BEQ EnemyDone
JMP EnemyLoop

EnemyDone:
RTS

WaveSpawn:

RTS

WaveReady:

LDA $C012
STA $C007
ASL
ASL

LDA $B000,Y
STA $C016
LDA $B001,Y
STA $C017
LDA $B002,Y
STA $C014
LDA $B003,Y
STA $C018
INC $C012
LDA $C012
AND #$07
STA $C012

WaveFindSlot:

WaveSlot:

ORA $C040,X
BEQ WaveCreate
INX
CPX #$04

RTS

WaveCreate:

STA $C030,X
LDA $C016

LDA #$00
